question: Should OpenClaw runtime Docker/Podman containers expose the agent workspace at `/workspace`, or should `/workspace` remain sandbox-only while runtime docs/templates use `/home/node/.openclaw/workspace`?
rationale: Both paths are plausible, but the choice changes a user-visible container contract across Docker, Podman, docs, and sandbox path semantics, so automation should not choose it unilaterally.

options.title: Implement a consistent runtime alias
options.body: Add a `/workspace` alias or equivalent bind contract across Dockerfile, Compose, Docker setup, Podman/Quadlet, docs, and smoke proof so container users have one ergonomic path.

options.title: Document sandbox-only semantics
options.body: Keep runtime containers on `/home/node/.openclaw/workspace` and update docs/templates that imply `/workspace` is generally available.

options.title: Defer behind DooD path work
options.body: Resolve the adjacent Docker Gateway/DooD sandbox path contract first, then apply one workspace path policy to runtime and sandbox containers.

recommendation.title: Implement a consistent runtime alias
recommendation.body: Add a `/workspace` alias or equivalent bind contract across Dockerfile, Compose, Docker setup, Podman/Quadlet, docs, and smoke proof so container users have one ergonomic path.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current-source history across Docker runtime paths and the original sandbox `/workspace` contract.
